decision.title: XPath and XQuery sweep: XInclude, ideographic numerals, place static contexts (packet )

body.p: , after , , , , , , , . No public header changed; IR fields sxml_ir_step.is_xnode_type_test and sxml_ir_static_call.namespace_bindings; a name role SXML_XPATH_NAME_ROLE_CONSTRUCTED_ELEMENT. Verified as asks: the debug preset (every unit and CLI test but evaluator_stream; the tree-sitter suite fails on 7.22's uncommitted baseline), clang-tidy on the changed files, the call-cycle check, and whole XP40, XQ40 and XT40 runs with the release drivers, case by case.

item.p: XInclude (XInclude 1.0; F&O 4.0, 17.1.1, 17.2.1; glossary xinclude, inclusion_fixup; 's cheapest not-run feature): src/function_library_xinclude.c copies a document into a new tree with each xi:include replaced by the document fn:doc gives for its href (resolved against the element's base URI: the loader's resolver, trust and stability), by text read as fn:unparsed-text reads it (parse="text", encoding), or by its xi:fallback's children after a resource error. One loop over an explicit stack of sibling cursors (); included documents are walked in the same loop; including a document already open is an inclusion loop. Top elements of an inclusion get xml:base (relative below the parent's directory) and xml:lang where they differ. Fatal errors are FODC0002 (F&O names no code), an include without trust-external FODC0016. Not supported: xpointer (a resource error, so a fallback applies), accept and accept-language (ignored). fn:doc, fn:doc-available and fn:parse-xml process after loading; XSLT's fn:document shares the option through sxml_function_library_read_document_options, so 's FODC0013 is gone there too (one hunk in 4.29's file). A document without the XInclude namespace is returned as it is; with includes the result is a new tree per call, as strip-space "all" gives (the draft's doc(x, {xinclude}) is doc(x, {xinclude}) does not hold). supports- xinclude is true; the QT4 driver lists xinclude-option, so fn-system-properties-supports-xinclude-false is not run any more. The CLI's fn:doc has it (xquery_xinclude tests); the book no longer says XInclude is unsupported.

Ideographic numerals (F&O 4.0, 4.6.1, implementation-defined sequences; glossary ideographic_numerals): the token U+4E00 numbers in Japanese numerals, as format-integer-052 expects; xsl:number shares it.
element() on JNodes (XPath 4.0, 4.7.5.5; 's item): element() and schema-element() select no JNode, * every one; the step records the form, as 's has_qualified_name_test.
Fixed default element namespace (XQuery 4.0, 5.14.1, 5.11): fixed for name tests and types; xmlns="" in direct constructors changes only prefix 0, which constructed element names use (2.1.4).

Namespaces of a call's place ( extended to static calls): an XQuery static call of a native row with USES_DYNAMIC_CONTEXT records the statically known namespaces of its place, which the callee reads; format-number's decimal format name in a direct constructor with xmlns:ex (eqname-007, 's and 's open item).

Smaller fixes: XQST0034 for a declared function named as an in-scope schema type's constructor (5.18); strip-space "all" keeps the whitespace of elements XSD validation gives simple content (F&O 4.0, 17.2.1), with fn:doc validating before stripping and stripped copies keeping types; fn:build-dateTime atomizes field values; collection documents with a document URI are fn:doc's documents (17.1.3); xml-to-json's top element may have escaped-key without key (17.4.7).

Measured (release drivers, whole runs; no case lost but the supports-xinclude-false case, now not run): start at 6236ab6, XP40 32,809 passed (30 wrong error), 31 failed; XQ40 46,138 (44), 90. At 384040b, after the XInclude commits and 5.16's: XP40 32,814 (27 failed), XQ40 46,146 (86). At bc7a35e: XP40 32,815 (26 failed), XQ40 46,154 (78 failed); this packet's share XP40 +4, XQ40 +12. XT40 12,261 unchanged (at 384040b with and without the changes). CONFORMANCE.md is not regenerated.

Not done, with causes: xqhof18 and xqhof19 (a function item that fn:function-lookup makes for a context-dependent row at run time, and fn:function-lookup#2 made in a library module, need a run-time closure that carries a module number and the reference's focus: an evaluator task bound to a module, medium); modules-43 (cyclic imports of named item types: modules are analyzed one at a time in reading order, so a module set needs a shared resolution round over all modules' types, medium); function-decl-40-060 (PR 2941: a default value that does not depend on the focus is computed once; it would become a hidden global of the declaring module, small to medium); 's record coercion cases (record-003, -005, -016): the draft rejects surplus entries (XPath 4.0, 3.4.2) and XDM 4.0, 8.3.2 makes a lookup of a non-field an error, which the tests contradict; fn-string-length-26 expects the string value of a validated element to be its text, where XDM 4.0, 7.5.2.4 says the schema normalized value; map-to-element-014, serialize-xml-157 and serialize-csv-002/-003 fail in XP40 only, because they use XQuery's character references in string literals; xml-to-json-065 (escaped on a map, which the schema of F&O 4.0, D.2 does not allow); XSLT's fn:document still strips before it validates (4.30's file); the kept groups of .
